verdict.rationale: Published board power, connector requirements and cooling guidance are a fair axis for any GPU, so the story applies. The evidence only gives system-level DGX B300 power details (12 PSUs in N+N redundancy, AC/PDU or DC/busbar versions). It has no per-card TDP/TGP, power-connector requirements or card-level cooling guidance a builder could spec against.

support.subject: As a gamer, I can spec a build around published board power — TDP/TGP, connector requirements, and cooling guidance for this exact card
